'''Scallops''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]], [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk-like]] [[Invertebrate/Legends|invertebrates]]. Their shells could often be found scattered along the [[Beach/Legends|beaches]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Scallops were dynamic creatures in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role playing-game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> They were first identified as scallops in the game's directory tree files, with the texture file listed as shor_seashell_scallops_a1.dds.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref>
